# Next Technologies

> Next Technologies (نيكست تيكنولوجيز) is a Riyadh-based technology advisory and solution architecture company. It helps organizations in Saudi Arabia make informed technology decisions and build connected, scalable IT environments. Advice comes first; delivery is coordinated with specialist partners when the client chooses.

- Website: https://nextec.sa (English), https://nextec.sa/ar/ (Arabic)
- Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
- Phone: +966 56 666 6711
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/next-technologies-sa
- Languages: English and Arabic

## How we help

- Advise: choosing a technology direction. Current-environment assessment, solution options and architecture, a prioritized roadmap.
- Connect: making systems work together. Integrated blueprints, integration and rollout planning, supplier and delivery coordination.
- Evaluate: buying against the right requirements. Requirements and RFP development, evaluation criteria and scoring, technical bid assessment.

## Solutions and services

- Cloud and hybrid: cloud readiness, landing zones, migration planning.
- Infrastructure and resilience: infrastructure design, backup and recovery, availability.
- Cybersecurity: security architecture, identity and access, solution evaluation.
- AI strategy and adoption: use-case prioritization, readiness, pilot planning.
- RFP and technical evaluation: requirements, RFP development, bid assessment.
- Retail and branch technology: ERP and POS, connectivity, branch rollout planning.

## How we work

1. Understand: objectives, current environment, constraints and success criteria.
2. Shape: compare options; develop architecture, roadmap and requirements.
3. Coordinate: align suppliers, interfaces and delivery responsibilities.
4. Review: review deliverables and support handover against acceptance criteria.

Deliverables, delivery ownership and specialist partner involvement are defined before work begins. Advisory and evaluation engagements clarify supplier relationships and commercial interests when scope is agreed.

A first conversation is a focused 45 minutes: https://nextec.sa/#contact
